units.source_text: 学校生活在信辅的记忆里都是阴暗的。

en.t: In Shinsuke's memory, school life was entirely gloomy.

units.source_text: 大学时期，除了几门不用做笔记的课程之外，他对其他任何课程都不感兴趣。

en.t: During his university years, apart from a few courses that did not require taking notes, he had no interest in any of the others.

units.source_text: 从初中到高中，从高中到大学，一级一级的读书，对他来说只是摆脱贫穷的自我救赎方法罢了。

en.t: For him, studying step by step from middle school to high school, and from high school to university, was merely a way of saving himself from poverty.

units.source_text: 本来信辅在中学时代并不认可这个事实，至少没有明确认可过。

en.t: Originally, during his middle school days, Shinsuke did not acknowledge this fact, or at least had never acknowledged it clearly.

units.source_text: 可是，从初中开始，贫穷像乌云一样开始盘踞在信辅的心头。

en.t: But from middle school onward, poverty began to settle over Shinsuke's heart like a dark cloud.

units.source_text: 在高中和大学时，信辅数次想要辍学。

en.t: In high school and university, Shinsuke wanted several times to drop out.

units.source_text: 但是，贫穷的威胁正预见着灰暗的未来，因此他总是轻易放弃辍学的打算。

en.t: But the threat of poverty foretold a bleak future, and so he always gave up the idea of leaving school quite easily.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，他憎恨学校，特别憎恨规矩特别多的初中。

en.t: Without question, he hated school, and he especially hated middle school, with all its countless rules.

units.source_text: 学校门房的喇叭声无比凄厉啊！

en.t: How unbearably shrill and mournful was the bugle from the school gatehouse!

units.source_text: 操场上枝繁叶茂的白杨树也无比忧郁啊！

en.t: How unbearably melancholy, too, were the leafy poplars on the playground!

units.source_text: 信辅在学校学到的都是一些无用的小知识，诸如欧洲历史的时间、没有实验的化学方程式、欧洲某城市的人口数量，等等。

en.t: What Shinsuke learned at school was nothing but useless scraps of knowledge, such as dates in European history, chemical equations without experiments, and the population of some European city.

units.source_text: 只要略微用点心，学习这些知识不一定痛苦。

en.t: As long as one paid even a little attention, learning such things was not necessarily painful.

units.source_text: 然而，事实上，想忘掉这些无用的小知识却并不简单。

en.t: Yet in fact, trying to forget these useless scraps of knowledge was by no means simple.

units.source_text: 杜思妥耶夫斯基的《死屋手记》里写过：“倘若强迫囚犯做无用的劳务，比如：

en.t: In Dostoevsky's Notes from a Dead House, it is written: "If prisoners were forced to perform useless labor, for example:

units.source_text: 把第一桶水倒进第二个桶里，再把第二桶水倒回第一个桶里，囚犯就会宁愿自杀。”

en.t: pouring the water from the first bucket into the second bucket, then pouring the water from the second bucket back into the first, the prisoners would rather kill themselves."

units.source_text: 在灰暗的校舍里，在摇曳的白杨树下，信辅感受到了囚犯所感受的精神痛苦。

en.t: In the gloomy school buildings, beneath the swaying poplars, Shinsuke felt the mental anguish that prisoners feel.
